speaker: BIANCA
description: A young female voice defined by a soft, refined, and elegant timbre. She maintains a composed, steady pace with a formal, dignified cadence and pristine clarity. Her emotional baseline is serene and pious, grounded by a solemn nuance that carries a subtle, fanatical intensity. Delivery should be polite, soft-spoken, and deeply controlled, subtly veiling an unwavering, zealous resolve.
ref_text: Greetings, Nameless Hero and the new Ice Sovereign. I am Bianca Anturaze. As the Saintess of Helize Church and a proxy of the Lord, I welcome you.
